newsitem.title: KENYA: First plane lands at Kenya's third main airport.
newsitem.headline: First plane lands at Kenya's third main airport.

text.p: Kenyan President Daniel arap Moi was among hundreds of people who witnessed the first plane to land at Eldoret airport in his native Rift Valley province on Friday, the Presidential Press Service reported on Saturday.

The construction of Eldoret as the third international airport in Kenya has been severely criticised by donors and opposition groups. The construction started in January 1995 and will be completed early next year.
Donors and Kenyan opposition groups argue an international airport is not one of Kenya's main priorities.

The government initially proposed to build the airport at the cost of $83 million, saying it would ease cargo congestion at the Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi -- especially for the export of flowers, coffee and maize.
Donor pressure forced a scaling down of the cost to $36 million. The airport is being constructed by SNC Lavalin.
